tools.name: enquiry_describe
tools.description: Read first. States plainly what submit_enquiry does on Sell VFX Data to AI: it starts an enquiry with Sell VFX Data to AI, whose team reads it and replies directly. Nothing is bought, ordered or paid; no quote is guaranteed; it is free. Also returns who receives the details, the consent wording, and how the person confirms.

tools.name: enquiry_fields
tools.description: Every field of the Sell VFX Data to AI enquiry: key, label, type, whether required, help text and the allowed options where there are any. Pass answers to submit_enquiry keyed by field key. With form, the questions of that guide's own form.

form.description: a guide's own form, for a different reader (for-ai-developers-vfx-studio-work); omit for the site's main form

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Submits an enquiry to Sell VFX Data to AI: NOT a purchase, NOT a guaranteed quote. Step 1: call with the answers (keyed by field key from enquiry_fields) and consent=true; it validates and returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token; show the person the summary and the consent line. Step 2: only if the person agrees, call again with the same answers, consent=true and the confirmation token; the enquiry is then submitted, and the person receives an email with a link they must click before the Sell VFX Data to AI team sees it. Consent means the person has read and agreed to: "A person at this site may read and reply." (with form, that guide's own consent line, which enquiry_fields returns)

answers.description: the person's answers, keyed by field key

consent.description: true only when the person has agreed to: A person at this site may read and reply. (or the chosen form's own consent line)

confirmation.description: the confirmation token from step 1, after the person has approved the summary

form.description: a guide's own form, for a different reader (for-ai-developers-vfx-studio-work); omit for the site's main form
